---
title: "Hazelnut exports"
title-tr: "Fındık ihracatı"
description: "Where Turkey's shelled hazelnut exports go, how the destinations have shifted since 2000, and what a kilo of kernels earns against the exchange price."
description-tr: "Türkiye'nin iç fındık ihracatı nereye gidiyor, pazarlar 2000'den bu yana nasıl değişti ve bir kilo iç fındık borsa fiyatına göre ne kazandırıyor."
---

```{python}
from hazelnut.site import charts, i18n
from hazelnut.site import page_helpers as ph
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, load_crops
from hazelnut.site.i18n import t

crop = load_crops()["hazelnut"]
data_dir = SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug
manifest = ph.read_json_or_none(data_dir / "manifest.json")
stamp = ph.as_of_stamp(manifest) if manifest is not None else None
K = f"{crop.slug}.analyses.exports"  # this page's strings in site/i18n

PRODUCT = "shelled"  # the bulk of the trade; in-shell exports are a few thousand tonnes a year
TOP = 3              # destinations drawn as lines

exports = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "exports_monthly.csv",
                              required=("month", "product", "partner", "net_kg", "fob_usd"))
unit_value = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "export_unit_value.csv",
                                 required=("month", "product", "usd_per_kg"))
prices = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "prices_monthly.csv", required=("month", "usd_kg"))

shares = ph.yearly_shares(exports, PRODUCT, top=TOP) if exports is not None else None
if shares is not None and shares.empty:
    shares = None

uv = None
if unit_value is not None and prices is not None:
    shelled = unit_value[unit_value["product"] == PRODUCT][["month", "usd_per_kg"]]
    uv = shelled.merge(prices[["month", "usd_kg"]], on="month", how="outer").sort_values("month")
    uv = uv[uv["month"] >= shelled["month"].min()]  # from the first export month
    if shelled.empty:
        uv = None
ratio = ph.ratio_stats(uv["usd_per_kg"], uv["usd_kg"]) if uv is not None else None
```

```{python}
parts = []
if shares is not None:
    first, last = shares.index[0], shares.index[-1]
    lead, second = shares.columns[0], shares.columns[1] if len(shares.columns) > 1 else None
    both = shares.loc[last, list(shares.columns[:2])].sum()
    pct = lambda partner, year: i18n.fmt_pct(float(shares.loc[year, partner]))  # noqa: E731
    who = i18n.join_names([i18n.country_name(p) for p in (lead, second) if p])
    parts.append(t(f"{K}.found_top", who=who, share=i18n.fmt_pct(float(both)), year=last))
    lead_values = dict(lead=i18n.country_name(lead), lead_first=pct(lead, first), first=first,
                       lead_last=pct(lead, last))
    if second:
        parts.append(t(f"{K}.found_lead_second", second=i18n.country_name(second),
                       second_first=pct(second, first), second_last=pct(second, last),
                       **lead_values))
    else:
        parts.append(t(f"{K}.found_lead", **lead_values))
if ratio is not None:
    parts.append(t(f"{K}.found_ratio", ratio=i18n.fmt_number(ratio.median, 1)))
found = " ".join(parts) or t(f"{K}.found_fallback")
ph.raw_html(ph.analysis_head_html(i18n.crop_name(crop), t(f"{K}.title"), t(f"{K}.h1"),
                                  found, stamp))
```

::: {.dash}

::: {#panel-destinations .panel .span-7}
```{python}
TITLE = t(f"{K}.destinations_title")
if shares is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, t(f"{K}.destinations_fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.share_shift_subtitle(shares, t(f"{K}.share_what"))))
    charts.show(charts.share_lines(shares, highlight=shares.columns[0]))
    foot = t(f"{K}.destinations_foot", n=len(shares.columns), year=shares.index[-1])
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(foot, quote=False)}</p>')
```
:::

::: {#panel-unit-value .panel .span-5}
```{python}
TITLE = t(f"{K}.unit_value_title")
if uv is None or ratio is None or ratio.n == 0:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, t(f"{K}.unit_value_fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.ratio_subtitle(
        ratio, t(f"{K}.ratio_a"), t(f"{K}.ratio_b"))))
    charts.show(charts.compare_lines(uv["month"], uv["usd_per_kg"], uv["usd_kg"],
                                     t("hazelnut.chart.shelled_exports"),
                                     t("hazelnut.chart.giresun_in_shell")))
    fob = '<a href="../../methods.qmd#fob">FOB</a>'
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{t(f"{K}.unit_value_foot", fob=fob)}</p>')
```
